common.readingDescription: Your types and their dates show here in a moment.
common.spacesUnreadable: Your spaces could not be read. {{detail}}
common.noDatedType: No type in this space has a date property yet.

footer.privacyNote: Keys are stored on this computer only. No account, no server copy.

start.step3: Type the 4-digit code Anytype shows you
start.title: Connect to Anytype
start.body: Open Anytype on this computer and leave it running. One key connects your whole account — every space you own — and the calendar reads through the local app.

code.title: Enter the code from Anytype
code.body: Anytype is showing a 4-digit code on this computer. Type it here to issue a key for your account.

apiKey.title: Paste your API key
apiKey.body: Already issued a key for this app in Anytype's API settings? Paste it here to connect without the code step.
apiKey.label: API key

verifyingKey.title: Verifying key
verifyingKey.body: Checking this key against your local Anytype app.

verifying.title: Verifying code
verifying.body: Exchanging the code for an API key with your local Anytype app.

invalidCode.title: That code did not work
invalidCode.body: The code expired or was mistyped. Codes last 60 seconds — request a new one and Anytype will show a fresh code.

expired.title: That code expired
expired.body: Codes last 60 seconds. Request a new one and Anytype will show a fresh code.

unreachable.title: Could not reach Anytype
unreachable.body: Make sure the Anytype desktop app is open on this computer, then try again.
unreachable.detail: The local Anytype app did not respond

invalidKey.title: That key did not work
invalidKey.body: Anytype did not accept this key. Check it was pasted in full, or issue a new one in Anytype's API settings.

success.title: Connected to your account
success.body: The key is saved on this computer and covers every space on the account. Pick which ones to show next.

emptyList.synced: No spaces on this account yet.
emptyList.offline: Your spaces will show once Anytype is back.
emptyList.error: Your spaces could not be read.

onboarding.label: Onboarding
onboarding.heading: Which objects belong on the calendar?
onboarding.lead: Your key covers every space on this account. Pick the spaces you want to see, then the types inside them. Each type needs one date to start from; a second date turns it into a range.
onboarding.pickSpace: Pick a space to see the types inside it.

spacePicker.heading: Spaces
spacePicker.note: Unchecked spaces stay hidden. Nothing is written back to Anytype.

typeCard.includesTimeDescription: Off draws every date all-day, on shows the time it was set.

config.title: Settings
config.intro: One key, read through the Anytype app on this computer. It covers every space on the account.
config.spacesAndTypesDescription: Which types generate events, and which dates they use
config.showWeekNumbersDescription: ISO weeks, beside each row of the month
config.createSpaceDescription: This account has no spaces yet. Read it again once it has one.
config.lastChangeFailed: Your last change could not be saved.
config.changesApply: Changes apply to the grid immediately. A type with a to date is drawn as a range.

session.heading: Session
session.signOutDescription: Forgets the key here. It stays valid in Anytype until you delete it there.
session.revokeInstructions: To revoke it for every space on the account, open the Anytype app, go to {{breadcrumb}} and revoke Calendar for Anytype. Then sign out here. Reconnecting means running the 4-digit code flow again.

calendar.nothingDatedDescription: Events of the types you track appear here once one of their dates falls in this month.
calendar.chooseWhatGoesOn: Choose what goes on the calendar
calendar.chooseWhatGoesOnDescription: Pick the spaces and types whose dates you want to see here.

nav.readOnlyTooltip: MVP: month view only, no editing

eventDetail.readOnlyNotice: This view is read-only. Edit the object in Anytype and it updates here on the next read.
